subject.title: [Bug]: openai-responses sends role="system" instead of role="developer" for reasoning models

question: For custom `openai-responses` providers, should OpenClaw support strict relays that reject prompt messages in `input` via an opt-in `instructions` placement compat key, a developer-role propagation fix, or no additional core behavior?
rationale: The report is valid for a real relay class, but the accepted fix changes provider request policy and may add a public config surface; a global default flip could break the opposite provider class that rejects `developer`.

options.title: Sponsor opt-in instructions placement
options.body: Keep current defaults and review or replace the linked candidate PR with documented config, request-shape tests, and upgrade-safe behavior for strict Responses relays.

options.title: Narrow role propagation fix
options.body: Fix only the `reasoning: true` path so this class can send `developer`, while accepting that relays rejecting prompt messages in `input` may still need a separate issue.

options.title: Decline core support for this relay class
options.body: Document `openai-completions` or relay-specific workarounds and leave strict `/responses` prompt-placement behavior outside OpenClaw core for now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor opt-in instructions placement
recommendation.body: Keep current defaults and review or replace the linked candidate PR with documented config, request-shape tests, and upgrade-safe behavior for strict Responses relays.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently moved and own the active @openclaw/ai provider boundary and have adjacent Responses request-shape history.
